help.playerengine.index_empty: No commands available to you here.
help.playerengine.relog.short: Re-authenticate every active companion with Player2.
help.playerengine.relog.long: Invalidates the cached Player2 auth token for each active companion so the next request forces a fresh sign-in.
help.playerengine.tpto.short: Teleport yourself to one of your companions by name.
help.playerengine.tpto.arg.username: The name of the companion to teleport to.
help.playerengine.help.short: Show this command list, or detailed help for a command.
help.playerengine.help.long: Use /playerengine help [page] to browse all commands, or /playerengine help <command> for detail on one.
help.playerengine.help.arg.command: A command path to show detailed help for.
help.playerengine.queue-clear.short: Flush pending AI work and shut down LLM buckets.
help.playerengine.queue-clear.long: OP-only. Flushes pending AI events and shuts down per-billing LLM buckets so a stuck or runaway queue can be recovered without a server restart. With a player argument it is scoped to that player's companions.
help.playerengine.queue-clear.arg.player: Limit the clear to this player's companions.
help.playerengine.resolve.short: Dry-run the deterministic material resolver for an item.
help.playerengine.resolve.long: OP-only debug tool. Runs the resolver against a live companion's current inventory and prints the resolution plan (status, sub-craft steps, external acquisitions, deficit). Makes no model calls and persists nothing.
help.playerengine.resolve.arg.item: The item to resolve (namespace defaults to minecraft:).
help.playerengine.memory-status.short: Show graph-RAG memory status for your companions.
help.playerengine.memory-status.long: OP-only diagnostics. Makes no model calls: prints the master flag, your owner patron/gate status, and per-companion node/edge counts, reflection importance, and summary state.
help.playerengine.rag-retrieve.short: Run RAG tool retrieval for a goal and print the top results.
help.playerengine.rag-retrieve.long: OP-only. Runs retrieval against the executing player's per-owner tool index and prints the top 5 results; category flags must precede the goal. Falls back to the global index from a non-player context.
help.playerengine.rag-retrieve.arg.goal: The natural-language goal to retrieve tools for.
help.playerengine.rag-retrieve.arg.categ: Optional category tag to restrict retrieval; repeatable before the goal.
help.playerengine.rag-reload.short: Reload all RAG overlay files and rebuild the index.
help.playerengine.rag-reload.long: Re-reads all overlay files from disk, rebuilds the global retriever, and evicts all per-owner caches.
help.playerengine.rag-audit-tail.short: Print the last N entries of the RAG alias-learning audit log.
help.playerengine.rag-audit-tail.arg.n: How many trailing audit rows to show (default 20).
help.playerengine.rag-reset-learned.shor: Clear learned RAG aliases for a tool or all tools.
help.playerengine.rag-reset-learned.long: Removes alias-learning data for the executing owner (or all owners with --all-owners), optionally scoped to a single tool.
Limit the reset to this tool id (omit for all tools).
help.playerengine.rag-reset-learned-all-: Clear learned RAG aliases across all owners.
help.playerengine.rag-inspect.short: Print the merged tool document for a tool id.
help.playerengine.rag-inspect.long: Shows all fields of the merged tool document for the executing player's index; keywords and examples added by an overlay are marked with [+].
help.playerengine.routing-probe.short: Dry-run the model-tier routing decision for a task class.
help.playerengine.routing-probe.long: OP-only, read-only (no HTTP). Shows the routing outcome for a task class, optionally simulating a joules balance or a soft-budget condition.
help.playerengine.routing-probe.arg.task: The AI task class to probe (e.g. CONVERSATION).
help.playerengine.routing-probe-simulate: Probe routing while simulating a soft-budget condition.
Probe routing while simulating a joules balance and a soft-budget condition.
help.playerengine.capability-query.short: Query the capability index for subjects matching text.
help.playerengine.capability-inspect.sho: Inspect the capability map for a subject.
help.playerengine.capability-inspect.arg: The subject kind (e.g. BLOCK, ITEM, ENTITY).
help.playerengine.capability-rebuild.lon: Re-runs capability ingestion in the background; add force to rebuild even when nothing changed.
help.playerengine.capability-rebuild-for: Rebuild the capability index even when nothing changed.
help.playerengine.capability-enrich.shor: Run a capability enrichment batch via the model.
help.playerengine.capability-enrich.long: Schedules an enrichment batch for queued capability entries; an optional limit overrides the per-launch config cap for this batch.
Max enrichment calls for this batch (0 = unlimited; overrides config).
help.playerengine.player2-reload.short: Reload the Player2 server config from disk.
help.playerengine.player2-payer-prompter: Set billing so the prompting player pays.
help.playerengine.player2-payer-owner.sh: Set billing so the companion's owner pays for all.
help.playerengine.player2-dedicated.long: When on, the server routes Player2 calls through a player's client proxy (for servers with no Player2 app installed).
help.playerengine.player2-owner-offline-: Toggle whether companions keep running when their owner is offline.
help.playerengine.player2-call-by-name.s: Toggle addressing companions by name in chat.
Set the max companions a player can have spawned at once.
help.playerengine.player2-npc-max-stored: Set the max stored character ids per player.
Maximum stored character ids per player (0-100).
help.playerengine.player2-chain-status.s: Show each active companion's agentic task-chain status.
help.playerengine.player2-chain-status.l: Lists every live companion with its current agentic run, active step, recent log, and task progress.
help.playerengine.player2-budget-soft.sh: Set the soft per-window AI call budget.
help.playerengine.player2-budget-soft.ar: Soft call limit per window (0 = disabled).
help.playerengine.player2-budget-hard.sh: Set the hard per-window AI call budget.
help.playerengine.player2-budget-hard.ar: Hard call limit per window (0 = disabled).
Set the budget window length in minutes.
help.playerengine.player2-budget-joules_: Set the soft joules budget threshold.
Set the hard joules budget threshold.
Set how often the joules balance is refreshed.
help.playerengine.player2-budget-fallbac: Set the fallback AI profile used on soft budget (or none).
Profile name, or none to clear.
On soft budget, switch to the fallback profile.
On soft budget, stop making AI calls.
help.playerengine.player2-budget-reset.s: Reset all budget counters and joules caches.
Show current budget thresholds and usage.
